title: Xiaomi MiMo V2.5 Pro open-source MoE model with 1T parameters
summary: Xiaomi released MiMo V2.5 Pro, a one-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts model with 42 billion active parameters, hybrid attention architecture and a one-million-token context window. The model is MIT-licensed and reportedly matches Claude Opus 4.6 and Gemini 3.1 Pro on certain coding and agentic benchmarks.

web_findings.title: MiMo V2.5 Pro coding benchmarks
web_findings.snippet: Roughly 57.2 percent on SWE-bench Pro, neighbourhood of Claude Opus 4.6.

web_findings.title: VentureBeat: open-source MiMo on agentic tasks
web_findings.snippet: Strong token efficiency on agentic coding benchmarks.
